profile.headline: Software Engineer | Cybersecurity | Open Source Software Advocate
profile.summary: Multi-faceted web developer and computer science educator with experience in full-stack, front-end, and mobile application development. Diversified skill sets in server-side scripting, database design, and project management with an emphasis on best practices and current industry conventions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led core automation feature, opening product line to enterprise customers
• Orchestrated regular deployments to staging and production environments
• Improved memory management by 50% and oversaw other key performance optimizations
• Utilized Google Cloud Platform for data storage and endpoint management in a serverless architecture
• Frequently wrote internal documentation, tests, and updates to CI/CD pipelines and build tools
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Serverless Computing · React.js · Firebase · Cloud Firestore

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the MVP development for the company's core second product from inception using Node.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL
• Architected application infrastructure hosted on AWS using key services including Elastic Beanstalk, SNS, RDS, and Lambda
• Instituted CI/CD tooling using GitHub Actions for regular deployments to staging and production environments
• Mentored junior engineers to help onboard to the new technology stack
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · PostgreSQL · GraphQL · Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Rebuilt legacy Emmy Award winning application to a modern stack using Node.js, React, MySQL, TypeScript, and Docker
• Worked along core team as an early engineering hire to establish methodologies for scalable building and collaboration across a
rapidly expanded team
• Mentored junior engineers in building and maintaining company's Angular application
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · MySQL · PHP

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Worked closely with the CTO as the first engineering hire to build core functionality of a Ruby application
• Developed reusable web components for seamless integration with third-party e-commerce platforms
• Created new workflows that cut development time by more than 50% including pre-processing and build pipelines for static asset
management

positions.title: Web Producer
positions.description:
• Managed a team of engineers and interns across distributed projects
• Maintained legacy .NET applications and oversaw the migration to custom in-house WordPress instances
• Improved page rank score by 90% for department-managed degree programs
• Chartered data analytics to provide feedback for UI/UX and user engagement
• Created and tracked email marketing campaigns sent to thousands of recipients
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · JavaScript · ASP.NET · Project Management

positions.title: Computer Science & Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
· Taught advanced computer science courses in front-end and PHP & MySQL based full-stack web development
· Created scripts using JavaScript to discuss computational analysis and mathematical algorithms
· Used a variety of software to enhance the classroom experience such as Moodle as a learning management system

positions.title: Computer Science & Mathematics Teacher, Digital Librarian
positions.description:
· Taught independent studies in advanced scripting courses
· Oversaw a Drupal based content management system in the first ever all digital library in a high school
· Created scripts in Python to produce visuals for Geometry classes

courses.name: Advanced JavaScript with Node.js and AngularJS

organizations.name: Online Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences
organizations.description:
Contributed updates to the online database OEIS (Online Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences).
